problem: GitHub website build parity was green while Netlify production failed because the GitHub parity build used STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=0 and production used STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1.
root_cause: The pre-merge build oracle did not execute the same fail-closed static i18n cache requirement as production. Build transforms could introduce new translatable strings after the standalone source cache test had already passed.
prevention: The website Netlify build-parity job must run the complete production build chain with STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1.
Standalone cache validation remains useful but is not sufficient because build transforms may add translatable strings.
Any missing post-transform translation must fail before merge and be repaired through the versioned static i18n cache patches.
Netlify production may only be called LIVE_BEWEZEN after exact-main deploy plus pricing/i18n browser proof.
Changes to lane-website.yml must self-classify as high-risk preview work so the production-parity guard proves itself.
